defects_found_and_fixed_during_construct: The first alias-continuation test failed: an alias registered for the same canonical directory created a second permanent project, because the continuation lookup chose the first row for that path, which was the brand-new alias itself. The lookup now prefers the binding that already owns a project.

Re-writing a stage or binding record at the same revision tripped the append-only guard; the records now advance by exactly one revision and the NOT_STARTED markers are created once and never promoted.

The scanner did not notice an NTFS junction planted inside the chosen directory: Windows reports a junction with irregular mode bits rather than the symlink bit, and filepath.EvalSymlinks refuses to resolve it, so both the obvious checks miss it. Detection now uses the reparse attribute on a handle opened without following the link, plus a root-escape comparison, and the case is asserted (MG18 proves it).
A reply cached for a repeat command nested the binding without its project, so the result now has to match the live binding row (REPLY-NESTED-WORKSPACE-* assertions).
not_verified_on_this_machine: MG17-replay-nests-a-pre-binding-workspace is a no-op mutation rather than an escape: the replay path reads the live binding row, so deleting the in-memory assignment changes nothing.
